accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Recipient's USDC ATA. For owner-claims, must be owned by signer.
For admin-claims, pass the owner's ATA in remaining_accounts[0] instead.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault authority PDA — not mutated here; only referenced for ATA derivation
and held for future CPI signing in other instructions.

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: The market's USDC escrow account — receives the trade fill amount.

accounts.name: user_token_account
docs: Trader's USDC token account — source of all payments.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: Treasury USDC ATA — receives the treasury fee leg.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Signer authorized to resolve this market (relayer or admin).
For the dispute path, must be an admin.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault needed for Breaking Market graduation sync.

accounts.name: creator_fee_vault
docs: Needed to pay out the creator's royalty if this call is what
triggers a Breaking Market's lazy primary→secondary transition.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Signer authorized to submit the oracle result (relayer or admin).

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault needed for Breaking Market graduation sync.

accounts.name: creator_fee_vault
docs: Needed to pay out the creator's royalty if this call is what
triggers a Breaking Market's lazy primary→secondary transition.

types.name: Event
docs: EVENT: The core market state.
LIFECYCLE:
1. Created via create_event (seed: 0.5–0.9 SOL; 1 SOL creation fee)
2. Primary reserve-driven trading phase
- Standard markets: before `start_time`
- Breaking markets: before `flash_acquisition_end`
3. Graduation
- Standard markets: when the vault reaches the configured liquidity
threshold and the market has at least 1 YES share and 1 NO share
outstanding
- Breaking markets: when `flash_acquisition_end` is reached
4. Secondary CLOB trading phase
5. Resolved by oracle after resolution_time

fields.name: active_volume
docs: Trading volume excluding the creator's seed deposit.
Counts actual trades only (primary fills + secondary matched fills).
Positioned after dynamic fields so old accounts fail with EOF, not OOM.

fields.name: is_whitelisted_creator
docs: True when the creator was whitelisted at market creation time.
Whitelisted creators earn 50% of fees; regular creators earn 20%.

fields.name: flash_acquisition_end
docs: Computed deadline for Flash Acquisition phase (unix timestamp).
For Standard markets this equals start_time (no behavioral difference).

fields.name: event_in_progress
docs: Whether the real-world event was already in progress at creation.

fields.name: primary_phase_end_time
docs: Precomputed primary phase end timestamp (unix timestamp).
Standard markets: created_at + compute_primary_duration(time_to_event).
Breaking markets: always flash_acquisition_end (primary_phase_end() ignores this).

fields.name: review_expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp when the currently pending review expires.
Set by report_primary_event / dispute_resolved_event; cleared to 0 by expire_review
or settle_resolution_dispute. 0 means no active review (or no expiry recorded).

fields.name: oracle_proposed_yes_wins
docs: The oracle's initial proposed answer, populated by submit_oracle_result.
Used during admin resolve to determine bond outcome when a dispute is active.

fields.name: oracle_result_submitted
docs: True once submit_oracle_result has been called.  Guards dispute and resolve.

fields.name: last_secondary_yes_price
docs: Price (on the `PRICE_SCALE` fixed-point scale) of the most recently
matched secondary-market trade on the YES side. 0 until a YES trade fills.

fields.name: last_secondary_no_price
docs: Price (on the `PRICE_SCALE` fixed-point scale) of the most recently
matched secondary-market trade on the NO side. 0 until a NO trade fills.

fields.name: graduation_requirements_met
docs: USDC markets only: true when the market's numeric graduation bar was
actually met at primary-phase-end (Standard: threshold+ratio; Breaking:
two-sided shares). `is_graduated` is unconditionally true for every USDC
market once its primary phase ends — this field is the FE/BE visibility
signal for "did it actually clear the bar," not a lifecycle gate.

fields.name: current_skew_bps
docs: Current market skew in basis points: max(yes,no) ÷ total shares.
5_000 = perfectly balanced (50/50); 10_000 = fully one-sided.
Updated at market creation and on every primary-phase trade.

fields.name: current_royalty_bps
docs: Current dynamic creator-royalty rate in basis points, derived from
`current_skew_bps` via the royalty tier curve.

fields.name: current_royalty_tier
docs: Current royalty tier, derived from `current_skew_bps`.

fields.name: royalty_penalty_active
docs: True whenever `current_royalty_tier != RoyaltyTier::Normal`, i.e. the
creator's royalty has been slashed below the base 20% rate.

types.name: RoyaltyTier
docs: Dynamic creator-royalty tier, derived from the market's current skew
(largest-side shares ÷ total shares). See the ROYALTY_* constants above
for the exact skew boundaries and royalty rates.

types.name: UserPosition
docs: FIX [M-02]: Added `is_initialized` flag to replace brittle Pubkey::default()
checks. Anchor's `init_if_needed` can lead to reinitialization vulnerabilities
when state is checked by comparing against a default Pubkey, because a legitimately
initialized account where the event field happens to be default would be re-init'd.

fields.name: is_initialized
docs: True after first initialization; prevents accidental re-initialization.

types.name: WinClaim
docs: WinClaim records a user's successfully executed winning-share claim.
Created atomically during `claim_win`. Its existence is the canonical
proof that the user has already claimed — Anchor's `init` constraint
rejects duplicate initialisation, so no separate flag is needed on
UserPosition.  Storing the share snapshot here lets the frontend display
"had X YES shares, claimed Y lamports" even after resolution.

fields.name: yes_shares_at_claim
docs: YES shares the user held at claim time (mirrors UserPosition.yes_shares)

fields.name: no_shares_at_claim
docs: NO shares the user held at claim time (mirrors UserPosition.no_shares)

fields.name: payout
docs: Lamports paid out to the user

fields.name: claimed_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the claim
